body_lead: CHENNAI: The state plans to introduce artificial intelligence (AI) education from the school level to university and create a dedicated AI ecosystem, including an "AI City", as it seeks to position the state as a leader in ethical AI and digital innovation, Tamil Nadu's Artificial Intelligence, Information Technology and Digital Services Minister R Kumar said on Thursday.
